title: RECAP: Calibrating Low-Bit Reasoning Models on the History They Read
abstract: arXiv:2610.15259v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-bit quantization reduces the cost of serving reasoning models but can substantially degrade long chains of thought. Each step reads cached keys and values spanning thousands of tokens, allowing quantization errors to accumulate along the trajectory. Standard calibration operates on short segments that omit the earlier context needed by later reasoning steps. Even when this context is retained, cache reconstruction error alone does not capture how quantization errors affect subsequent attention. We present RECAP, a post-training quantization method that calibrates reasoning models on the history they read. Dynamic-prefix calibration separates long historical context from short-block reconstruction. It regenerates prefix keys and values with the current quantizer and rotates the active block to supervise every position along the trajectory. translated_title: RECAP：基于模型所读取的历史内容校准低比特推理模型
translated_abstract: 低比特量化降低了推理模型的部署成本，但会显著损害长思维链的质量。推理模型的每一步都会读取跨越数千个token的缓存键和值，导致量化误差沿推理轨迹不断累积。标准的校准方法仅在短片段上运行，忽略了后续推理步骤所需的早期上下文。即使保留了这些上下文，仅凭缓存重建误差也无法反映量化误差对后续注意力机制的影响。我们提出了RECAP，一种在模型实际读取的历史内容上进行校准的训练后量化方法。动态前缀校准将长历史上下文与短块重建分离开来，使用当前量化器重新生成前缀的键和值，并轮换活动块以监督轨迹上的每一个位置。前缀读取几何进一步根据历史缓存误差对后续注意力的影响进行监督（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出RECAP训练后量化方法，通过动态前缀校准和前缀读取几何，在推理模型实际读取的长历史上下文上进行校准，从而解决低比特量化在长思维链中的误差累积问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RECAP, a post-training quantization method that calibrates reasoning models on the long historical context they actually read, using dynamic-prefix calibration and prefix read geometry to address quantization error accumulation in long chains of thought.
